doc.title: Sheila Jordan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: No formal musical training; grandmother's background
summary: She had no training beyond Mr. Rushing and learned entirely by ear; her grandmother had been raised Catholic with piano training.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I want to talk about any early musical training. You were in high school. You had Mr. Rushing but no training.
No…? How about church? No church?

Uh, my grandmother… my grandfather, of course, was not into organized religion, you know, not at all. But my grandmother had been raised a Catholic. And she grew up with a… well, actually, her mother had her out of wedlock, and she had put my grandmother on a pretty wealthy couple‟s doorstep, and that‟s how my grandmother was raised. So she had musical training with a piano and everything. But uh, but I never, I never had any, any kind of musical training. It was all hearing. But you know…
